mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notification_prefs (user_id, bill_due_enabled, overdue_warning_enabled, large_tx_enabled, goal_deviation_enabled, quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{billDueEnabled}, #{overdueWarningEnabled}, #{largeTxEnabled}, #{goalDeviationEnabled}, #{quietHoursStart}, #{quietHoursEnd}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notification_prefs SET bill_due_enabled = #{billDueEnabled}, overdue_warning_enabled = #{overdueWarningEnabled}, large_tx_enabled = #{largeTxEnabled}, goal_deviation_enabled = #{goalDeviationEnabled}, quiet_hours_start = #{quietHoursStart}, quiet_hours_end = #{quietHoursEnd}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
